name: GuardSpine Governance
description: Deny-by-default governance layer. Gates dangerous tool calls through L0-L4 risk tiers with evidence packs, 3-model council review, L3.5 Opus tie-breaker, pattern authorization bypass, and remote approval.

enforcement_mode.label: Enforcement Mode
enforcement_mode.help: enforce = block unauthorized actions, shadow = evaluate and log without blocking, audit = development-only pass-through, disabled = no checks

council_endpoint.label: Council Endpoint
council_endpoint.help: Ollama-compatible endpoint for L3 council review. Required in enforce/shadow mode.

discord_approval_target.label: Discord Approval Target
discord_approval_target.help: Discord target for L4 approvals (e.g. user:123456789 or channel:123456789)

discord_bot_token.label: Discord Bot Token
discord_bot_token.help: Bot token for Discord reaction-based L4 approval
